blocks.label: Introduction
Having a proper interface setup is important as it allows you to organize your game view and hav

children.text: Having a proper interface setup is important as it allows you to organize your game view and have quick, convenient access to game windows that you frequently interact with such as inventory, gear, familiars, ability bars and so on. A good interface can make the game easier to play and more enjoyable.

Creating a good interface is all about displaying the interface elements in a way where everythi

children.text: Creating a good interface is all about displaying the interface elements in a way where everything you need to access is open and important elements are appropriately close to one another, to minimize the distance your eyes and mouse need to travel around your screen.
